components.name: Transformed Battle Cat (4 rounds)
notes: Damage-over-time effects are excluded.
Active transformation only: replaces the normal attack, expires after 4 rounds, and is not averaged over a run.
Transformation is selected as an attack component; its sentinel timer is excluded. Four-round expiry is not a duration in seconds.
One placed power and one selected attack component; consumable quantities and encounter availability are not simulated.
